title: Erdős #604: Pinned Distance Problem — Complete Proof

problemStatement.formal: \forall n \geq 2,\ \exists A \subset \mathbb{R}^2,\ |A| = n,\ \forall x \in A,\ |\{d(x,y) : y \in A\}| \leq \frac{n}{\sqrt{\log n}}
problemStatement.plain: Given n distinct points in the plane, must some point have nearly n distinct distances to other points? The 'pinned' version of the distinct distances problem. OPEN with $500 prize.
